name: Swain
notes: Opens with Demonic Ascension (R) at t=0, entering the drain stance; the stationary dummy counts as a drained enemy champion, so Demonic Energy regen (10 per 0.5s while draining a champion) always outpaces its decay (5 per 0.5s, 7.5 after 5s), so the stance never lapses and R is cast only once for the whole fight.

Death's Hand (Q) is resolved as a single damage instance using the sheet's own 'total damage when all five bolts land' figure (base*2, AP ratio 0.9): the dummy is stationary and always takes all five bolts, and this total matches exactly what you get by taking the wiki's 25%-bonus-per-subsequent-bolt escalation to its 5th bolt, so the two documented models agree at this target.

Every cast (R, Q, W, E, and Demonflare) has a stated 0.25 s (0.5 s for R) cast time: it lands its own damage or effect at the moment it starts, then keeps Swain from starting any other cast or attack until it ends, so R's opening cast blocks Q/W/E from firing in the same instant, and each of Q/W/E in turn blocks the others.
Vision of Empire (W) is cast on cooldown; its damage lands 1.5 s after its cast time ends, as stated.

Nevermove (E) is assumed cast at maximum range every time, so the wave always homes back and detonates on the dummy; there is no single stated detonation delay, so the outgoing-then-return missile travel described on the wiki is approximated as a flat 1.0 s from the end of its cast time to the detonation's damage (an assumption, see 'assumed').
Nevermove's recast (the pull) deals no damage and only grants a Soul Fragment (self-heal/health, irrelevant here), so it is never cast.

Demonflare becomes castable 2 s after Demonic Ascension's cast time ends and is then recast manually every time it comes off cooldown; the only cooldown value in the files (8 s) is flagged by the wiki as possibly tooltip-only, but it is the only number available, so it is used (see 'assumed'); Demonflare's own 0.25 s cast time (stated on its wiki template) also keeps it from overlapping another cast.
Ravenous Flock (passive) only grants bonus health and self-healing on Soul Fragment pickup, never damage, so it is omitted entirely.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16 given this rotation.
Swain still auto-attacks with basic attacks between casts (no on-hit or attack-speed steroid in his kit), since his ability cooldowns leave idle time in a longer fight.

assumed.why: Nevermove's cast-to-detonation delay is not given as a single number; approximated from the wiki's described outgoing (~0.585s to max range) and return (~0.4s) missile travel times.

the only Demonflare cooldown value present (8s) is flagged by the wiki as possibly tooltip-only/unused, but it is needed to model repeated manual Demonflare casts during the permanent Ascension stance.
